verdict: A quiet day for production-relevant AI tooling; the only story with real pipeline substance is Maxon's opt-in AI add-on, surrounded mostly by trailers, listicles, and VFX-breakdown PR.

stories.headline: Maxon launches Maxon Plus, an opt-in AI add-on sold separately from Cinema 4D and ZBrush subscriptions
stories.body: Maxon Plus adds AI-generated base models, texture exploration, and browser-based 3D review on top of Cinema 4D and ZBrush. It is sold as a separate add-on rather than bundled into Maxon One, and CEO David McGavran told AWN this is deliberate so generative AI stays opt-in rather than forced into the main subscription. No pricing or licence terms for generated assets were detailed in either report.
stories.why: Signals how a major DCC vendor is gating AI features and licensing them separately from core tools.
